### Marcus Theatres Sets More Records with Highest Summer Revenue of All Time


September 8, 2026


*Strong film slate drove multiple all-time summer records at Marcus Theatres*


MILWAUKEE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Marcus Theatres®](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F&esheet=54600026&newsitemid=20260907754540&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Theatres%26%23174%3B&index=1&md5=d2bfbbe7b58f2507a91d1861383acc1e) , the nation’s fourth largest theatre circuit and a division of[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54600026&newsitemid=20260907754540&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=2&md5=096f80ec8caea19e21335e85a3811415) (NYSE: MCS), announced today that it recorded its highest total revenue for the summer moviegoing season in company history, defined as the first Friday in May through Labor Day.


Fueled by blockbuster hits and a diverse slate of summer releases that appealed to a wide range of audiences, summer records set at Marcus Theatres include:


- Highest total summer revenue in company history.
- Highest box office for any summer.
- Highest summer concession, merchandise, and food and beverage revenue of all time.
- Highest per capita summer admission revenue and per capita concession, merchandise, and food and beverage spend for the summer moviegoing season.
- Highest summer attendance since 2019.
- Highest premium large format screen attendance and percentage of attendance and box office for any summer.


Following the carryover success of *Michael* , the summer got off to a hot start with *The Devil Wears Prada 2* and surprise hits like *Obsession* and *Backrooms.* The sustained excitement for *Toy Story 5,* which had the highest opening weekend for an animated film since 2019, propelled Marcus Theatres to multiple June records. And while *The Odyssey* continued its record-breaking journey, becoming the highest-grossing R-rated movie worldwide in history, *Spider-Man: Brand New Day* swung onto the scene, with the biggest domestic opening of all time. Combined, *The Odyssey* and *Spider-Man: Brand New Day* led to multiple all-time August records for Marcus Theatres, including highest attendance for the month of August and highest August box office in company history.


The summer of 2026 finished strong as the top grossing summer domestic box office of all time. We estimate more than 335 million people went to see the latest films on the big screen, showcasing the wide-reaching influence and enduring power of moviegoing, and the significant impact it has on the economy.


“Our outstanding summer performance delivered numerous records and lots of happy moviegoers who enjoyed some of the best performing movies of all time on the big screen,” said Jeff Tomachek, president of Marcus Theatres. “The tremendous turnouts for a wide range of diverse films created unique memory-making moments for all audiences – from the tears to the laughter to the thrills and chills – that cannot be replicated at home. As we look ahead to the rest of the year, several new and highly anticipated films await, giving moviegoers even more reason to enjoy a great time at the movies with friends and family.”


The film slate for the remainder of the year includes: *Practical Magic 2* (September 11) *, Resident Evil* (September 18) *, Forgotten Island* (September 25) *, Digger* (October 2) *, Verity* (October 2) *, Other Mommy* (October 9) *, The Social Reckoning* (October 9) *, Street Fighter* (October 16) *, Clayface* (October 23), *The Cat in the Hat* (November 6) *, Godzilla Minus Zero* (November 6) *, Ebenezer* (November 13), *The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping* (November 20) *, I Play Rocky* (November 20), *Hexed* (November 25) *, Focker-In-Law* (November 25) *, Dune: Part Three* (December 18) *, Avengers: Doomsday* (December 18) *, The Angry Birds Movie 3* (December 23), *Jumanji: Open World* (December 25), and *Werwulf* (December 25).


The Marcus Theatres experience stands out for the latest in amenities, technologies, and entertainment offerings. That includes premium large format screens, such as *Ultra* Screen DLX®, *Super* Screen DLX®, IMAX and ScreenX, DreamLounger® luxury recliner seating, along with a variety of enticing food and beverage options offered at in-theatre dining, bars, and lounges. Marcus Theatres continues to invest in making moviegoing easier, more convenient, and more memorable. In addition to the highest concentration of PLF screens and luxury seating among the top chains, Marcus Theatres also continues to enhance the out-of-home entertainment experience with amenities such as RealD 3D, 4DX, and D-BOX premium haptic and motion seating. The company also recently introduced a new digital ticketing experience online, along with a redesigned website that makes it easier for guests to book their tickets and plan their visit. Together with engaging promotions and programs, these innovations help create memorable movie moments on the big screen.


Tickets and showtimes for all Marcus Theatres and Movie Tavern locations can be found at[marcustheatres.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F&esheet=54600026&newsitemid=20260907754540&lan=en-US&anchor=marcustheatres.com&index=3&md5=339168007d57b23b08c02959ae985740) and the Marcus Theatres mobile app.


**About Marcus Theatres**


[Marcus Theatres®](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F&esheet=54600026&newsitemid=20260907754540&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Theatres%26%23174%3B&index=4&md5=4b6c8f6c2f29cbba3bd6635dd2382e9b) , a division of[Marcus Corporation,](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54600026&newsitemid=20260907754540&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation%2C&index=5&md5=6a7e900b1343ede7a32fef28d618e217) is the fourth-largest theatre circuit in the United States and currently owns or operates 975 screens at 77 locations in 17 states under the Marcus Theatres, Movie Tavern® by Marcus and Bistro *Plex* ® brands. **About Marcus Corporation**


Headquartered in Milwaukee,[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54600026&newsitemid=20260907754540&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=10&md5=bff0e47c0fd2234a8a7f221d7992091c) is a leader in the entertainment and hospitality industries, with significant company-owned real estate assets. In addition to its Marcus Theatres division, its hospitality division,[Marcus® Hotels & Resorts](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcushotels.com%2F&esheet=54600026&newsitemid=20260907754540&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus%26%23174%3B+Hotels+%26amp%3B+Resorts&index=11&md5=b9521f30ee9919fcc835fde0d1569e8e) , owns and/or manages 17 hotels, resorts and other properties in eight states. For more information, please visit the company’s website at[www.marcuscorp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54600026&newsitemid=20260907754540&lan=en-US&anchor=www.marcuscorp.com&index=12&md5=c9d5adc4b6e4735baf0437b90e4af191) .
